summary: First test run for Senderos Auténticos travel agency. Backend 17/17 pytest tests passed (public CRUD reads, reservation create, JWT auth, admin trip/reservation/gallery/testimonial CRUD, 401 on unauthenticated admin endpoints). Frontend Playwright covered home, /viajes (lists 4 trips, filter buttons present), trip detail (reservation form with 4 inputs), /galeria (6 images), /sobre-mi, /contacto (form rendered), admin login (token stored in localStorage as admin_token, redirect to /admin, 'Bienvenido' toast), admin dashboard tabs (Viajes/Reservas/Galería/Testimonios all visible and loading data), and admin logout (token cleared + redirect to /admin/login). All critical flows work end-to-end.

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout after N failed logins (playbook recommends lockout after 5). Not enforced — a security hardening gap, but not blocking for single-admin MVP.
Accepts raw dict payload; only `status` is whitelisted but not validated against the allowed set (nuevo|contactado|confirmado|cancelado). Any string is accepted.

issues: React hydration warning in console: <span> cannot be a child of <option> — caused by ve-dynamic instrumentation wrappers inside <select><option> in Contact.jsx. Cosmetic dev warning only, does not break the form.

action_items: (Optional) Validate reservation status enum on PUT /api/admin/reservations/{rid} to reject arbitrary strings.
(Optional) Add login lockout / rate limiting on /api/auth/login.
(Optional) Suppress hydration warning on Contact <select><option> by ensuring no wrapper <span> is rendered inside <option>.
critical_code_review_comments: JWT secret correctly read from env; bcrypt hash format ($2b$) used via bcrypt.hashpw — OK.
seed_admin is idempotent and re-hashes if the env password changed — OK.
_id is excluded from all Mongo reads via projection {"_id": 0} — OK.
Public reservation endpoint does not require auth (correct per requirements).
Bearer token fallback is implemented in get_current_admin alongside cookie — matches the K8s-ingress note in the brief.
CORS uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True; CORS_ORIGINS env var is unused (dead config).
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 4 trips, 6 gallery photos, 3 testimonials, and 1 admin user on startup. Test data created during pytest is cleaned up by the tests themselves (TEST_ prefix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all endpoints. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Admin login uses Bearer token in Authorization header (cookies are stripped by K8s ingress per agent_to_agent_context_note). Trip detail reservation form has unnamed inputs — use placeholder selectors ('Tu nombre', 'Correo', 'Teléfono / WhatsApp', 'Personas'). Admin login submit button has no type='submit' attribute — select via text 'Entrar' or first button. Logout button text is 'Salir'.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Minor hydration warning on /contacto caused by ve-dynamic instrumentation injecting <span style='display:contents'> wrappers inside <option> children — this is platform/devtool-level, not a real bug in app code.
